description:
Get gnomAD genetic constraint metrics for a target.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_constraint — one record = one gnomAD constraint metric (syn, mis or lof) of one gene.
Key: id, constraint[].constraintType.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: one row = one item (one gnomAD constraint metric (syn, mis or lof) of one gene); `_vbt.total` counts items.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. gnomAD constraint metrics integrated by OT 25.09; a gene with no metrics was not assessed.

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
